description: Pre-registered replication of exp-v1 on the SAME substrate with ONE change: Qwen3 thinking enabled on policy (act-mode) calls only, capped by a thinking budget (Amendment 11). Regimes, seeds, episodes, agents, agent_params, prices, prompts: byte-identical to exp-v1. World-model calls stay thinking-off and regex-constrained exactly as in exp-v1.

alternate_prices.note: claude-haiku-4-5 table; Design decision 1 sensitivity check for the writeup

amendment_note: 2026-09-10 (Amendment 11, zero exp-v2 runs executed): exp-v1's registered verdict was MATCHES with the act mode dead on this substrate (non-thinking Qwen3-8B answers 'probe' on every policy call; verified verbatim, results/exp-v1-analysis/policy-reply-diagnostic.md). Thinking ON makes the same model move sensibly but unbounded reasoning costs 1k-4.5k output tokens per policy call. exp-v2 tests bounded reasoning: budget 512 first; the SOLE registered fallback is 1024 if the pre-declared policy gate is RED at 512. Policy gate (before the 600-run): reactive-only on easy-7, 20 seeds x 10 episodes; GREEN iff move fraction >= 0.50 AND success rate >= 0.15 (lower 95% bound of the mock random policy's 0.21 on easy-7 over 200 episodes; the gate detects a dead policy, not superiority); else RED. Price table unchanged (thinking tokens are output tokens under the registered table, so act becomes the expensive mode - that is the experiment). forced_answer added to the step schema (additive, nullable). exp-v1 hashes are unchanged; exp-v2 conditions hash differently and never collide with exp-v1 runs.

regimes.name: easy-7
regimes.note: Small grid, sharp probes, two mild shifts. The regime the smoke runs lived in; kept as the floor of the difficulty spread.

regimes.name: mid-11
regimes.note: Middle of the road: bigger search space, moderate relocations.

regimes.name: hard-15-far
regimes.note: Large grid, large relocations: stale beliefs are maximally misleading and re-exploration is expensive.

regimes.name: hard-11-blunt-probe
regimes.note: Evidence is costly: probe radius 1 means gather_evidence needs many steps to pay off, stressing the spend-on-evidence tradeoff.

regimes.name: turbulent-11
regimes.note: Frequent alternating shifts: recalibration never gets to settle, stressing recovery speed rather than one-off adaptation.
